item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:20 HKT 27/Jul/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Tropical Cyclone Doksuri will move across the northeastern part of the South China Sea today and tomorrow, and gradually move towards the coastal areas of eastern Guangdong and southern Fujian. Under the influence of its outer subsiding air, very hot weather will persist over southern China today with showers and squally thunderstorms triggered by high temperatures. Under the influence of Doksuri and the subsequent active southwesterly airstream, it will be windy with squally showers over the coast of southeastern China tomorrow and on Saturday. A broad trough of low pressure is expected to bring showers to the coast of southern China early to midweek next week.

Date/Month: 27/07 (Thursday)
Wind: North to northwest force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore and on high ground later.
Weather: Mainly fine. Extremely hot during the day. A few showers and squally thunderstorms later. There will be swells.
Temp range: 28 - 35 C
R.H. range: 60 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium
